# SandUI LLM Index

SandUI is a TypeScript UI Library of accessible React components for dashboards, SaaS products, microservices, and internal tools.

## How to use

- Install: `npm i @sandurtech/sandui`
- Import from package entrypoint: `import { SandButton, SandModal, SandInputGroup } from '@sandurtech/sandui'`
- Every component supports semantic HTML, forwarded refs, and package-ready composition.

## Components

- `SandButton`: Primary action component. Props: `variant` (`primary | secondary | outline | success | failed`) plus standard button attributes.
- `SandInput`: Base text input. Props: standard input attributes plus `error`.
- `SandInputGroup`: Labeled input wrapper. Props: `label`, `helperText`, `groupClassName`, and all `SandInput` props.
- `SandCard`: Semantic content container. Props: `header`, `footer`, and article attributes.
- `SandBadge`: Inline status label. Props: `variant` (`primary | secondary | success | failed`) and span attributes.
- `SandDivider`: Semantic separator. Props: standard `hr` attributes.
- `SandKBD`: Keyboard shortcut primitive. Props: standard `kbd` attributes.
- `SandBreadcrumbs`: Hierarchical navigation. Props: `items` with `{ label, href? }` and nav attributes.
- `SandPagination`: Paged navigation. Props: `currentPage`, `totalPages`, `onPageChange`, and nav attributes.
- `SandCheckbox`: Checkbox control. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandRadio`: Radio control with keyboard arrow navigation. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandSwitch`: Switch control. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandChoiceGroup`: Choice container. Props: `label` and div attributes.
- `SandToast`: Live-region feedback message. Props: `heading`, `message`, `action`, `variant`.
- `SandSnackbar`: Compact live-region feedback message. Props: `message`, `action`, `variant`, `heading?`.
- `SandCodeBlock`: Code snippet viewer. Props: `code` and pre attributes.
- `SandCodeTabs`: Keyboardable code tablist. Props: `tabs`, `defaultTab`, `onTabChange`, `className`.
- `SandModal`: Accessible dialog. Props: `open`, `onClose`, `title`, `description`, `footer`, `closeOnOverlay`, `initialFocusRef`. Static subcomponents: `Header`, `Body`, `Footer`, `Title`, `Description`.
- `SandContainer`, `SandHeader`, `SandToolLayout`, `SandToolPanel`, `SandResultPanel`, `SandMicroserviceLayout`: layout primitives for structured interfaces.

## Documentation routes

- `/`: Introduction
- `/design-tokens`: Design Tokens
- `/typography`: Typography
- `/kbd`: SandKBD
- `/buttons`: SandButton
- `/inputs`: SandInput and SandInputGroup
- `/cards`: SandCard
- `/selection`: SandCheckbox, SandRadio, SandSwitch, SandChoiceGroup
- `/navigation`: SandBreadcrumbs and SandPagination
- `/feedback`: SandToast and SandSnackbar
- `/modals`: SandModal
- `/utilities`: SandBadge and SandDivider
